dsDescriptionValue.value:
Data for the paper entitled "Participatory planning practice in rural Indonesia: A sustainable development goals-based evaluation" published in Community Development Journal, DOI: 10.1080/15575330.2020.1765822.
Data was collected from the questionnaire, interviews, and focus group discussion with participants of Musrenbang in Deli Serdang district, Indonesia. Most of the data was written and transcribed in the Indonesian language.
